title: So pretty but needs improvement
text: So pretty but needs improvement. I ooo’d and ahhhh’d when I unpacked this. It’s so bright and shiny! It’s fun to hold. The base has a rubber ring so it’s non-slip. But as soon as I filled it, popped the lid on and took a drink I was disappointed. The lid is thick and chunky and it’s almost impossible to take a clean sip. It captures liquid in it and drips down. It’s also not ergonomically correct so it’s awkward to line your lips up with the opening. Also, after 2 weeks of use with only sparkling water, the copper at the top has come off. I included a picture.
